name: Geryon the Watcher of the Skies
description: (Tag:flying)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:ranger)Geryon, the Watcher of the Skies, is a Supreme Demon amalgam of numerous demons whose consciousnesses act in tandem. With great physical abilities, Hell Energy lasers and explosives, and a bow of flesh, he is an efficient hunter and combatant.
